input.content:
## Description

Session rows now show target, harness, model, lifecycle, and last-event columns, replacing the single-character agent mark with readable names. small terminals shrink the the model column and the last-event column ahead of name, target, and harness, and attention state stays separate from harness lifecycle and last event.

- Harness labels come from the daemon agents.list answer over configured gateway labels, which also seed the client before the first answer and after a restart.
- Model aliases resolve at draw time; an unmapped alias shows the raw string, never a catalog guess.
- The target column appears when several targets exist even when all rows uses one.
- Gateway env values and helpers stay out of agents.list, covered by a redaction test; model strings like glm-4.6 in tests are fixtures only.
- Rendered rows below show a wide and a narrowed overlay.

Wide:

```text
●!  auth-bug         imp-box GLM (z.ai) glm-5.3 suspended needs input
◐   docs             local   Claude             running   working
✓   groksess         local   Grok               running   turn done
```

Narrowed (model and last event crowd out first):

```text
●!  auth-bug         imp-… GL… suspended
◐   docs             local Cl… running
✓   groksess         local Gr… running
```

## Testing

- [x] `bun run typecheck` passes
- [x] `bun run test` passes (2958 pass, 3 skip, 0 fail; e2e 60/60)
- [x] `bun run lint` passes
- [x] New tests added for new functionality

## Context

Independent Codex review returned 3 findings; all are fixed in this branch.
